rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: Raise LMS-031 exception if p_window_days is null or outside 1..90 inclusive.
rules.notes: Declared parameter is int; no default used in check.

rules.title: NPA classification skip
rules.statement: For any loan with asset_class = 'NPA', increment p_skipped and skip all further processing for that loan.

rules.title: Missing benchmark error
rules.statement: Raise LMS-005 exception if benchmark_code is null on an otherwise eligible floating loan.

rules.title: Next reset date calculation
rules.statement: Compute months since disb_date as (years*12 + months), floor to multiple of reset_months, then add one reset_months interval to obtain v_next from disb_date.
rules.notes: Uses integer division semantics on the extracted month count; no day-count convention applied.

rules.title: Notice date weekday adjustment
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday, plus 1 day if Sunday, otherwise unchanged (next weekday on or after reset).
rules.notes: Uses extract(dow) with no holiday calendar.

rules.title: New rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_new equals the most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= v_next (or 0 if none) plus coalesce(spread_pct, 0).
rules.notes: No rounding function applied to the resulting numeric.

rules.title: Old rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_old equals the most recent benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= (disb_date + (v_months - reset_months) months) (or 0 if none) plus coalesce(spread_pct, 0).
rules.notes: No rounding function applied to the resulting numeric.

rules.title: Minimum rate change threshold
rules.statement: Skip and increment p_skipped when absolute difference between v_new and v_old is less than 0.25.
rules.notes: Comparison uses numeric subtraction; threshold is hard-coded 0.25.

rules.title: Duplicate notice suppression
rules.statement: Skip and increment p_skipped when a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists with note matching 'reset ' || v_next || '%'.
rules.notes: Uses LIKE pattern on note column; no check on amount or entry_date.

rules.title: RESET_NOTICE ledger insert
rules.statement: Insert one row into loan_ledger with entry_type RESET_NOTICE, amount = v_new, entry_date = v_notice, and note containing the reset details; increment p_posted.
rules.notes: No declared precision on amount column; amount receives the computed numeric directly.

open_questions: Confirm that missing benchmark rates are intentionally treated as 0 rather than raising an error or using a prior rate.
Confirm that the month-based reset calculation (integer division then add reset_months) matches intended cycle logic for all reset_months values.
Confirm that duplicate suppression relies solely on the note text pattern rather than a dedicated flag or date column.
